stats.Effect: An evil witch of a heretical religion who serves Antharas and sacrifices humans in her rituals. By using Dark Arts on herself, she was able to transform her body into that of a powerful evil spirit. She and her minions will attack any invaders who disrupt Antharas' sleep. Through a lifetime of slaughter, she has transformed into a powerful creature of evil. Now, she enjoys eating human hearts still pumping with warm blood.
